titleEn: I Will Just Take a Look

pages.text: A winter market filled the square. The smell of roasting chestnuts reached the alley.
Nono wanted hot chestnuts. A long line stood at the stall.
He stood at the back. The line shortened very slowly.
Boom, boom went a drum elsewhere. Nono turned. "I will just take a look."
He fluttered over to watch, hopping every time the drum boomed.
When he returned, the line was gone. The chestnut tub was empty too.
He looked at his empty hands. Only the delicious smell remained.
Wiping the empty tub, Grandpa Badger asked, "Who saved your place?"
The next day, Nono lined up again. The drum sounded again, but he kept his feet firmly planted.
At last, his turn. He received hot chestnuts in both hands.
